sourceText.he: וְעַל כּוּלָּן אִם אָמַר ״שֶׁהַכֹּל״ וְכוּ׳. אִתְּמַר. רַב הוּנָא אָמַר: חוּץ מִן הַפַּת וּמִן הַיַּיִן. וְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן אָמַר: אֲפִילּוּ פַּת וְיַיִן.

positions.claim: SheHakol exempts over all foods except bread and wine
positions.basis: bread and wine have blessings of their own

positions.claim: SheHakol exempts even over bread and wine
